review_findings.title: Private response-size constant blocks compilation
review_findings.details: Independent cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets fails with E0603: openai_compatible.rs imports MAX_STREAMED_RESPONSE_BYTES, but the constant remains private in ollama.rs. Expose it through a narrow pub(crate) interface or avoid the import while preserving the existing response-size bound.
